name: Henri Pescarolo
features: full black beard, dark eyes, green helmet, tall solid build
bio: Pesca, the bearded Parisian medical student who became Matra's most loyal driver and, later, the man with thirty-three Le Mans starts and four wins. In 1970 he shared the works MS650 with Beltoise and drove it through the Le Mans night rain when the Ferraris had gone.
